name: audit
description: Manifest-driven, model-aware, test-driven audit/fix pipeline. Ships /audit:status|next|run|phase|review|resume|report (execution), /audit:init (multi-agent manifest generation), /audit:task (task creation), /audit:bug (bug tracking with red-first TDD fixes), /audit:sync (Azure DevOps work-item sync), /audit:usage (token spend attributed by phase/task/model/author, with cache economics and trend), /audit:panel (local config + composition + usage control panel with skill/agent discovery), /audit:migrate (convert to the sharded manifest layout for fewer tokens + parallel-safe phases), /audit:worktree (set up a git worktree for a phase to run it in a parallel session), plus plan-first + secret-safety + token-logging + TDD-reminder guard hooks. Parameterized per-repo via .claude/audit.config.json — no company/project coupling.
